source: Launch overhead becomes especially relevant when work is fragmented into many tiny kernels. The ZXNAME0000XZ may have enormous arithmetic capacity, but if each launch performs too little work, host dispatch and kernel boundaries can become visible in wall-clock time. ZXNAME0001XZ Graphs and fusion are later-series topics that address parts of this problem.
zh: 当工作被分割成许多微小的内核时，启动开销变得尤其重要。 ZXNAME0000XZ 可能具有巨大的算术能力，但如果每次启动执行的工作太少，主机调度和内核边界可能会在挂钟时间内变得可见。 ZXNAME0001XZ 图和融合是解决此问题部分内容的后续系列主题。
